entities.summary: Tayanna (b. 1984-09-29, Chernivtsi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Chernivtsi and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
